entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Hmmm... So that ace detective[n]is serious, huh?

entries.en: I see...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Well, um... I ended up finding out about...[n]your criminal record.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I realized you weren't just some ordinary[n]kid back with my chief...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: So I did some digging out of curiosity...[n]and I found a ton more than I was expecting.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: So... sorry about that.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I have to say though, the ruling[n]made in your case was really odd.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Some kind of deal must have gone[n]down behind the scenes to make[n]sure that was the end result.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: That must've been tough for you to handle.[n]You're just a kid...

entries.en: Well, just forget about the past![n]We're in the same boat when [n]it comes to being labeled.
Because of your investigation?
Because of your incident?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Exactly. I'm going to avenge[n]my partner for—

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...Whoops.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Exactly. I've made a vow to avenge my[n]partner for—

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...Whoops.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I absolutely am. That's why I've vowed[n]to avenge my partner for—

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...Whoops.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: No. It's your turn to tell the truth.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: You can't go rooting around[n]in the kid's past and expect to[n]keep your own secrets hidden.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: W-Wait, don't blame me for that!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: He doesn't have anything to do with[n]my private business...
I'm curious.
You can trust me.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: So you're poking into my[n]past out of mere curiosity...?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I mean, it's not like I don't trust you...[n]and hold on a sec! Why am I getting[n]treated like the bad guy!?

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Look, you're gonna feel way better talking[n]to someone who understands exactly[n]what you're going through.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Besides, you'll explode if you[n]keep all that alcohol-fueled[n]anxiety bottled up in you.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: That's true. And... I guess this[n]is the fairest course of action for[n]our business partnership, huh?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Just... don't tell anyone, okay?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Back when I covered politics for my[n]publisher, I had a partner who helped[n]with photography... Kayo Murakami.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: We were a pretty well-known team[n]in the industry. We blew the lids[n]off countless scandals together.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...That is, until that day came.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: We were on the trail of a certain[n]bureaucrat, who was involved in [n]a slush fund to support refugees.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: He kept himself pretty well guarded,[n]so it was almost impossible to get[n]any solid leads on the guy...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Then one night, I got a voicemail[n]from Kayo saying she had gotten hold[n]of something big.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: But... that was the last[n]I ever heard from her.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: The next day, that bureaucrat was found[n]dead at a love hotel... and Kayo[n]had gone missing.
What was the cause of death?
Who killed him?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Well...

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: The cause of death is unknown...[n]The authorities couldn't tell whether it was[n]a murder or a suicide.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: As for the killer...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: The police accused Kayo! They said she[n]killed him in a crime of passion...!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: That's impossible though! She[n]never would have slept with a [n]disgusting man like that!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: And more importantly, it's pretty damn[n]fucked up to make allegations like that[n]without any evidence!

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Ichiko-chan.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...Sorry.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: The case was closed, but we never found[n]the truth... and Kayo was labeled[n]a professional disgrace.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: And since we were partners, the company[n]decided it would be best to move me[n]to another department.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I'm going to prove Kayo's innocence[n]though. That's why I'm conducting[n]my own private investigation now.
That sounds like defamation.
That's unforgivable.[clr 27]
How's your search going?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Exactly. Funny how common stuff like[n]that's become these days.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...You're damn right.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Not great.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: The incident happened over a year ago,[n]so almost everyone's forgotten about it[n]by now.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: But... thanks to all the info you've been[n]giving me, I should have more time to focus[n]on my investigation.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I won't let this opportunity[n]slip through my fingers.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...All right, we're even now![n]I didn't enjoy it though.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: You sure about that? It's been ages since[n]I've seen you smile this much.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: W-Well... maybe you're right. I haven't[n]felt this alive in a long time.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Okay then, I'll write a great article[n]to commemorate our sharing session!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: "Exclusive: The Phantom Thieves'[n]Lofty Ideals in Connection[n]with a Secret Society!"

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Haha, just kidding! Don't worry,[n]I'll definitely come up with a better[n]headline before we go to print!
I feel like my bond with[n]Ohya is growing deeper...
entries.uk: Відчуваю, що мій зв'язок з Оя[n]глибшає...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Still... there's just one[n]thing that bothers me.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: There's no doubt the chief[n]is on to my investigation.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Maybe we should keep acting like a[n]couple so we can trick him.[n]How's that sound?

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Oh, leave the kid alone.
